title: UK Graduate Visa (PSW): who can apply, when and how much it costs
summary: Check when your university reports course completion, what the January 2027 change means, and whether a direct work visa switch is possible.
content:
# UK Graduate Visa (PSW): who can apply, when and how much it costs

Last updated: 2026-11-26

## When can you apply?
The Graduate visa lets eligible students work or look for work without an employer sponsor. The usual route is to apply in the UK while your Student or Tier 4 (General) permission is valid, after a qualifying higher education provider with a track record of compliance tells the Home Office that you successfully completed an eligible course. A graduation ceremony or certificate is unnecessary. Check the qualification list and UK study rule. For courses lasting up to 12 months, the usual rule is the full course in the UK on Student permission. For longer courses, it is at least 12 months of qualifying UK study. Check permitted study abroad, historical distance learning exceptions and atypical qualifications separately. You cannot get Graduate permission again if you were previously granted it or permission under the Doctorate Extension Scheme. [Course and eligibility rules](#guide-evidence-eligible)

## The application date sets the length
For a qualifying non-doctoral course, an application made on or before 31 December 2026 leads to 2 years if approved. An application on or after 1 January 2027 leads to 18 months. A qualifying doctorate still leads to 3 years. Permission starts on the decision date, even if an eligible December application is approved in January. If the university expects to report completion after your Student permission ends, speak to its visa team promptly. Do not apply early on the assumption that the university will report later, or wait in the UK after expiry without a lawful basis. [Duration and reporting](#guide-evidence-timing)

## Apply and budget in this order
Check your eVisa and passport details, get the CAS reference from your Student application, and gather any requested documents. If a government or international scholarship agency covered both fees and living costs for a UK course you completed within the 12 months before applying, get its written consent. Apply through GOV.UK, pay, follow the identity or biometrics instructions and save the submission acknowledgement. At the verification date, the fee was £937 and the IHS was £1,552.50 for 18 months, £2,070 for 2 years, or £3,105 for 3 years. For example, a 2-year applicant would budget £3,007 for the fee plus IHS at those rates. Check fees before paying and budget separately for each eligible family member. [Application, evidence and fees](#guide-evidence-apply)

## Work, travel and study conditions
A decision usually takes up to 8 weeks after application, identity and documents. Leaving the UK, Ireland, Channel Islands and Isle of Man area whilst the application is pending withdraws it. If your existing permission has expired and section 3C applies, check the separate effect of leaving the UK on that permission. Your Student work conditions still matter while waiting. Under ST 26.6, the permanent full-time vacancy exception can apply once you have successfully completed a full-time course at degree level or above with a compliant provider, applied validly for Graduate permission while holding Student permission and are awaiting a decision. Check the conditions with the university and employer. Ask for advice if a refusal or review is involved. After approval, most work including self-employment is permitted, except professional sport. There is no access to public funds, and study that meets the Student-route criteria at a Student sponsor is restricted. Check ATAS if relevant. [Pending applications and grant conditions](#guide-evidence-conditions)

## Check each dependant separately
Existing eligible Student dependants can usually apply separately in the UK. Some children born in the UK during qualifying Student or Graduate permission can also apply. A new partner who never held Student dependant permission cannot normally join on this route. If granted, a dependant’s Graduate permission usually ends on the main applicant’s expiry date. Check evidence, costs and expiry for each person. [Dependant rules](#guide-evidence-family)

## When might a direct switch make sense?
If you have a qualifying job offer and the employer can sponsor before your deadline, compare Skilled Worker directly. Check course completion and the other Student-switch exceptions against the Rules. Eligible new entrants can use specific salary provisions, but the 4-year combined permission limit includes Graduate time as well as Skilled Worker and Tier 2. A job alone does not qualify. Graduate permission cannot be extended and gives no direct route to settlement. If facing delayed results, refusal, a cancellation notice or uncertainty about permission, get regulated advice. [Switching and new entrants](#guide-evidence-switch) · [Find advice](#guide-evidence-advice) · [Compare routes and expiry plans](/en/work-visa/uk-options-after-graduation) · [Skilled Worker salary and occupation](/en/work-visa/skilled-worker-occupations-salary)
